name: Hreyfill
tagline: Taxi quotes, nearby cars and bookings with Hreyfill
description: Check taxi prices, nearby cars and your bookings with your existing Hreyfill app login. You can also prepare bookings and cancellations, but these actions have not yet been tested with a real booking.
examples: How much would this taxi journey cost?
What bookings do I have coming up?
Are there any taxis near my pickup point?
auth: none for service information; phone (SMS code in the Hreyfill app) for quotes and bookings, using an imported session

tools.name: hreyfill_get_quote
tools.description: Calculate a taxi fare quote; does not book a ride or provide an arrival time.

tools.name: hreyfill_cc_auth_failed
tools.description: Report a failed card authorization; confirm=true required. Payment flow unverified.

tools.name: hreyfill_cc_check_auth
tools.description: Check or finalize a card authorization; confirm=true required. Payment flow unverified.

tools.name: hreyfill_get_payment_windows
tools.description: Start card enrollment; confirm=true required. Browser handoff is not implemented.

tools.name: hreyfill_get_receipt
tools.description: Download the PDF receipt for a booking.

tools.name: hreyfill_cancel_order
tools.description: Preview or cancel a booking; execution requires confirm=true. Not ride-tested.

tools.name: hreyfill_create_order
tools.description: Preview or create a taxi booking; execution requires confirm=true. Not ride-tested.

tools.name: hreyfill_get_most_recent_order_today
tools.description: Show the most recent booking from today.

tools.name: hreyfill_get_order
tools.description: Show the details of one booking.

tools.name: hreyfill_get_order_history
tools.description: List past bookings, with a maximum result count.

tools.name: hreyfill_get_order_upcoming
tools.description: List upcoming bookings.

tools.name: hreyfill_remove_order
tools.description: Preview or remove a booking from history; requires confirm=true. Not ride-tested.

tools.name: hreyfill_get_address
tools.description: Look up an address from coordinates using your own Google Maps key.

tools.name: hreyfill_get_address_details
tools.description: Look up address details for a Google place ID using your own key.

tools.name: hreyfill_get_autocompleted_addresses
tools.description: Find matching places using your own Google Maps key.

tools.name: hreyfill_get_autocompleted_addresses_strict
tools.description: Find matching places within a search area using your own Google Maps key.

tools.name: hreyfill_get_directions
tools.description: Get driving directions using your own Google Maps key.

tools.name: hreyfill_get_places_extra_details
tools.description: Look up details of a Google place using your own key.

tools.name: hreyfill_get_call_list
tools.description: List taxi service contact numbers; no login required.

tools.name: hreyfill_get_transportation_options
tools.description: List vehicle and journey options; no login required.

tools.name: hreyfill_delete_payment
tools.description: Preview or delete a saved payment method; requires confirm=true. Untested live.

tools.name: hreyfill_delete_user
tools.description: Preview or delete the account; requires confirm=true. Partial request schema; unverified.

tools.name: hreyfill_get_user
tools.description: Show the signed-in user profile.

tools.name: hreyfill_modify_payment
tools.description: Preview or edit a saved payment method; confirm=true required. Partial schema.

tools.name: hreyfill_set_favourite_address
tools.description: Preview or set a favourite address; confirm=true required. Untested live.

tools.name: hreyfill_set_user_data
tools.description: Preview or change saved vehicle preferences; confirm=true required. Untested live.

tools.name: hreyfill_update_attributes
tools.description: Preview or edit the user profile; confirm=true required. Partial request schema.

tools.name: hreyfill_update_phone_settings
tools.description: Preview or initialize device settings; confirm=true required. Partial schema.

tools.name: hreyfill_get_walkthrough_screens_configuration
tools.description: Read the service’s introductory information; no login required.

tools.name: hreyfill_get_driver_image
tools.description: Download the driver image for a booking.

tools.name: hreyfill_get_trip_path
tools.description: Get the recorded route for a booking.

tools.name: hreyfill_send_rating
tools.description: Preview or submit a trip rating; confirm=true required. Not ride-tested.

tools.name: hreyfill_remove_companyprofile
tools.description: Preview or remove a company account link; confirm=true required. Untested live.

tools.name: hreyfill_set_companyprofile
tools.description: Preview or link a company account; confirm=true required. Untested live.

tools.name: hreyfill_nearby
tools.description: Watch nearby taxi positions for a bounded interval.

tools.name: hreyfill_live
tools.description: Watch a booking’s live status for a bounded interval. Not ride-tested.

envVars.name: HREYFILL_ACCESS_TOKEN
envVars.description: Use an existing Frogne session token instead of the stored session

envVars.name: HREYFILL_PHONE_ID
envVars.description: Device identity for the imported session; needed for quote and booking requests

envVars.name: HREYFILL_FIREBASE_TOKEN
envVars.description: Existing Firebase context for requests that require it; no automatic refresh

envVars.name: HREYFILL_GOOGLE_API_KEY
envVars.description: Your own Google Maps key for optional address and directions tools; may incur charges

envVars.name: HREYFILL_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES
envVars.description: Set to 1 to expose MCP write tools; each call still requires explicit confirmation. Login stays CLI-only.

is.tagline: Verð fyrir leigubílaferðir, bílar í nágrenninu og bókanir hjá Hreyfli
is.description: Skoðaðu verð fyrir ferð, leigubíla í nágrenninu og bókanirnar þínar með innskráningu úr Hreyfilsappinu. Þú getur líka undirbúið bókanir og afbókanir, en þær aðgerðir hafa ekki enn verið prófaðar með raunverulegri bókun.
examples: Hvaða ferðir á ég bókaðar fram undan?
